description: This file defines classes, functions, and data structures related to input event processing, specifically for managing unwanted interactions such as palm rejection in Android's input system. It includes interface implementations, palm rejection logic, and utilities for handling motion events and device info.

classes.name: UnwantedInteractionBlocker
classes.description: Implements input event filtering, including palm rejection, acting as a stage in input processing pipeline.

classes.name: SlotState
classes.description: Maintains state of touch pointers and their associated slots for input event processing.

classes.name: PalmRejector
classes.description: Handles palm detection and rejection for a specific input device.

methods.name: createPalmFilterDeviceInfo
methods.description: Creates device info object with palm filter parameters from input device info.

methods.name: removePointerIds
methods.description: Removes specified pointer IDs from motion event args, updating the action and pointer info.

methods.name: cancelSuppressedPointers
methods.description: Cancels suppressed pointers based on old and new suppression sets.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts touch event data to string for debugging.

methods.name: UnwantedInteractionBlocker
methods.description: Class constructor and destructor, methods for handling input device changes, motion, and other input events.

methods.name: SlotState
methods.description: Methods for updating and dumping slot state, and retrieving slot for a pointer ID.

methods.name: getTouches
methods.description: Converts Android motion events to Linux input stream format, considering device info and slot states.

methods.name: PalmRejector
methods.description: Class for palm detection, processing motion events, and managing device info and filters.
